text:
How do you confuse a punk?
Offer them a mud bath.
A punk greeted an anime fan and became the first punk to wash a hand.
To become a true punk, you only need three things... and never wash them.
A Russian punk is a quiche with red mold.

A punk walks into a bar with a parrot on their shoulder. The bartender asks:
— Wow, where did you get that thing?
The parrot replies:
— At the dump. They are everywhere there.

Someone asks a punk:
— Do you like works of art?
— No.
— Do you like cars?
— No.
— Do you like women?
— No.
— Then what do you like?
— An armored vehicle.
— Why?
— It is covered in rivets and it rocks.

Walking down the street, an old man sees the word ‘hoi’ on a wall.
— Kids these days... making a spelling mistake in a word like that!

A punk is sitting on a trash can, smoking.
A cop walks up and says:
— What, can’t you read? It says: ‘For Trash.’
— Oh, sorry. Have a seat.

Two aging punk musicians meet:
— So, how is life? What’s new?
— Good. I released a new record.
— Sold anything yet?
— Yeah. My house, apartment, and car...

A mother packs her son’s school lunch:
— Here, I put bread, sausage, and nails in your backpack.
— Mom, what the fuck?!
— You take bread, put sausage on it, and eat it.
— What about the nails?
— There they are!
A bear walks through the forest, sees a burning car, sits in it, and burns to death.

I will never forget my grandfather’s last words. He asked:
— Are you holding the ladder properly?
A pathologist affectionately called every corpse ‘kitty’ because their noses were cold.
